links.name: transfers
links.title: 转账关系
links.build_sql: SELECT txn_id, from_raw AS from_account, to_raw AS to_account, amount, date FROM obj_transaction

links.name: calls_to
links.title: 通话关系
links.build_sql: SELECT c.call_id, p1.person_id AS from_person, p2.person_id AS to_person FROM obj_call c LEFT JOIN obj_person p1 ON p1.raw_name = c.caller_raw LEFT JOIN obj_person p2 ON p2.raw_name = c.callee_raw

links.name: owns
links.title: 持有账户
links.build_sql: SELECT a.account_id, p.person_id AS owner_person, a.raw_name AS owner_raw FROM obj_account a JOIN obj_person p ON p.raw_name = a.raw_name

links.name: involved_in
links.title: 中标参与
links.build_sql: SELECT o.org_id, b.project_id, b.winner_raw FROM obj_bid_project b JOIN obj_org o ON o.raw_name = b.winner_raw

links.name: co_located
links.title: 同地点出现
links.build_sql: SELECT t1.track_id AS track_id_1, t2.track_id AS track_id_2, p1.person_id AS person_1, p2.person_id AS person_2, t1.location, t1.date FROM obj_trackpoint t1 JOIN obj_trackpoint t2 ON t1.location = t2.location AND t1.person_raw <> t2.person_raw AND ABS(date_diff('day', CAST(t1.date AS DATE), CAST(t2.date AS DATE))) <= 1 LEFT JOIN obj_person p1 ON p1.raw_name = t1.person_raw LEFT JOIN obj_person p2 ON p2.raw_name = t2.person_raw

links.name: time_window
links.title: 时间窗碰撞
links.build_sql: SELECT b.project_id, t.txn_id, b.title, t.from_raw AS owner_raw, t.amount, date_diff('day', CAST(b.pub_date AS DATE), CAST(t.date AS DATE)) AS offset_days FROM obj_bid_project b JOIN obj_transaction t ON ABS(date_diff('day', CAST(b.pub_date AS DATE), CAST(t.date AS DATE))) <= 20 AND CAST(t.amount AS BIGINT) % 10000 = 0 AND t.from_raw NOT LIKE '%公司%'

links.name: decision_for
links.title: 决定针对线索
links._note: 运行期链接：Action 执行器创建 obj_decision 时同步写入 lnk_decision_for，不参与编译期物化

links.name: tipoff_targets_person
links.title: 举报针对人员
links.build_sql: SELECT t.tipoff_id, p.person_id, t.target_raw, t.title AS tip_type, t.submit_date FROM obj_tipoff t JOIN obj_person p ON p.raw_name = t.target_raw

links.name: osint_mentions
links.title: OSINT提及主体
links.build_sql: SELECT a.article_id, p.person_id, a.raw_name AS subject_raw, a.source_name, a.pub_date FROM obj_osint_article a JOIN obj_person p ON p.raw_name = a.raw_name
